escort.name: Escort & Protection
escort.description: Guard duty and safe passage missions

mission_templates.name: Clear Slime Infestation
mission_templates.description: A local farm has been overrun by slimes. Clear them out before they damage the crops.

mission_templates.name: Goblin Patrol Elimination
mission_templates.description: Goblin scouts have been spotted near the trade road. Eliminate the patrol before they establish a camp.

mission_templates.name: Destroy Bandit Hideout
mission_templates.description: A well-fortified bandit camp threatens merchant caravans. Coordinate an assault to eliminate the threat.

mission_templates.name: Dragon Lair Scouting
mission_templates.description: Ancient dragon movements have been detected. Scout the suspected lair and report findings without engaging.

mission_templates.name: Escort Merchant to Market
mission_templates.description: A traveling merchant needs protection on the road to the next town's market day.

mission_templates.name: Guard Noble's Caravan
mission_templates.description: A wealthy noble requires armed escort through dangerous territory. Discretion and professionalism required.

mission_templates.name: Escort Refugee Families
mission_templates.description: Families fleeing the demon advance need safe passage to the protected settlements.

mission_templates.name: Gather Healing Herbs
mission_templates.description: The local healer needs rare herbs found only in the forest's deeper sections.

mission_templates.name: Mine Precious Ore
mission_templates.description: A vein of mithril ore has been discovered in abandoned mines. Extract what you can before cave-ins occur.

mission_templates.name: Retrieve Ancient Artifact
mission_templates.description: Scholars have located a powerful artifact in ruins guarded by ancient traps and creatures.

mission_templates.name: Investigate Spy Network
mission_templates.description: Enemy agents may be operating in the city. Investigate suspicious activities without raising alarm.

mission_templates.name: Find Missing Caravan
mission_templates.description: A supply caravan has vanished on a well-traveled route. Find what happened and recover any survivors.

mission_templates.name: Investigate Demon Cult
mission_templates.description: Rumors of demon worship threaten the kingdom's stability. Gather evidence while avoiding detection.

mission_templates.name: Deliver Urgent Message
mission_templates.description: Time-sensitive correspondence must reach its destination before sunset.

mission_templates.name: Emergency Supply Transport
mission_templates.description: A remote outpost is running low on critical supplies. Deliver goods through hostile territory.

mission_templates.name: Deliver Diplomatic Package
mission_templates.description: Sensitive diplomatic materials must be delivered intact to prevent international incident.

mission_templates.name: Repair Strategic Bridge
mission_templates.description: A bridge critical to trade routes has been damaged. Oversee repairs while defending against raiders.

mission_templates.name: Construct Border Watchtower
mission_templates.description: Build a fortified watchtower to monitor demon army movements along the border.

mission_templates.name: Reinforce Fortress Defenses
mission_templates.description: A key fortress needs urgent reinforcement before the next demon offensive.

trading_season.description: Peak trading season brings more escort and delivery contracts

demon_activity.description: Increased demon activity creates urgent military contracts

mission_chains.description: A connected series investigating and eliminating bandit threats
